regime_context: US thematic tape shows AI Infrastructure (SMH proxy) as the ranked leader, closely challenged by US Energy Complex (XLE), with rotation breadth narrowing (45% eligible) and no single dominant narrative. The absolute-trend gate helps on this market's history, but cross-sectional momentum is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0) and rotation timing has no validated edge; recent macro flow is dominated by markets/ai_tech/geopolitics with high unscheduled-surprise share, so I treat all leans as low-conviction conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Infrastructure to US Energy Complex: if energy's breadth remains above 0.5 while AI Infrastructure's breadth stays below 0.2 for five consecutive sessions and the rotation margin (currently 0.185) widens further, the handoff is confirmed; if AI Infrastructure's breadth recovers above 0.3 and the margin narrows instead, retire the watch.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex (XLE) is the #2 rank and the rotation challenger with much higher breadth (0.636 vs 0.125 for the AI leader) and a higher durability bar (0.62 vs 0.50). The absolute-trend gate is eligible (true), and the combination of stronger breadth plus trend-health makes this the cleanest trend-following, vol-aware lean available; the narrowing rotation view means I do not chase the thin leader, and energy's breadth suggests resilience if AI's one-narrative structure wobbles.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed but absolute-trend gate eligible
theses.dissent: Energy complex may simply be a cyclically late, oil-price-driven bounce with no structural AI-demand link; mixed hurst suggests the trend is not clean and a mean-revert regime in related energy names could chop XLE sideways.

falsifier.text: XLE drops below its own 20-day absolute-trend threshold and fails the eligibility gate before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity (CIBR) ranks #3 and is trend-eligible with a strong durability bar (0.75), but it is flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.61). Crowding is not a fade trigger per guardrails — it caps exposure, not reverses. Given the track record's weak direction accuracy (0.46) and the display-only nature of rank, I lean underweight relative to cleaner leaders rather than overweight; the crowding flag argues for restraint, not aggression.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a sizing caution only, never a sell/short
theses.dissent: A high durability bar (0.75) with trend tag could just mean the theme is genuinely strong and the crowding simply marks broad participation; underweighting it in favor of lower-durability names may leave performance on the table.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks out to a fresh 20-day high while maintaining its trend-gate eligibility and crowded flag drops below 1.0 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure (SMH) is the ranked leader and headline theme, but its breadth is only 0.125 and durability bar is just 0.50 (the lowest of the top-ranked eligible themes). The rotation view is 'narrowing' with absorption 0.31 and one_narrative false, so leadership is thin. The tracker itself cautions not to read a high rank as a buy, and the backtest shows no rank-based return edge. I avoid chasing a leader that is narrow and not a confirmed one-narrative regime.
evidence: guardrails: momentum rank is not a return forecast or buy list
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure is still the leader and the dominant macro narrative is ai_tech; avoiding it entirely could mean missing the strongest absolute-trend continuation if breadth is simply not yet fully formed.

falsifier.text: AI Infrastructure's breadth rises above the energy complex's breadth and a one-narrative structure confirms before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
